research_rules: Test one genuinely distinct pre-registered family per research iteration.
Use completed candles and next-open fills; never use future information.
Use development selection, chronological folds, cost stress and one sealed final evaluation.
Correct for multiple testing; never tune on the sealed final.
Reject a signal screen before building execution code when raw cost-adjusted expectancy is negative or evidence gates fail.
Do not optimize to a requested monthly profit target or infer monthly profit from a small sample.
A pass permits paper validation only; live requires separate explicit approval.
next_queue: Keep admitted perpetual 30-day TSMOM forward paper settings frozen and collect real forward evidence.

Do not open the sealed final for BTC lead-lag, broad-spot path continuity, broad-spot 3-week momentum, or broad-spot low-volatility; gather genuinely new future data or preregister a structurally independent mechanism before revisiting.
Investigate quarter-hour crypto-futures microstructure only if public trade-level data can support realistic fee-aware out-of-sample testing; never substitute coarse candles and call it replication.
Test simple volume/flow-confirmed trend mechanisms, basis/funding dislocations, and event-conditioned risk premia only with decision-time features and strict costs.
Do not retune any rejected rule on opened sealed data.
Construct a portfolio ensemble only after a second independently admitted low-correlation edge exists.
